sources: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234480 (+ /rates and the public per-site search catalog)
https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/alerts (nothing for Swan Lake Campground or Hwy 83), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 38 family sites (24 reservable, 14 walk-up) plus a reservable group site for up to 100 people; paved parking areas. Ponderosa Loop has open, large sites; Birch Loop's are shaded and more clustered.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/swan-lake-campground ('38 family-sized campsites and large group site with paved parking areas', 'Max trailer length is 50 feet') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234480 ('24 sites are reservable and 14 sites are for our walk-up visitors'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov public campsite catalog for facility 234480 (all 38 RV/trailer sites typed STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No dump station, but a water fill station just past the pay kiosk at the entrance. Firewood sold by the host; kayak, paddleboard and canoe rentals.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234480 ('Drinking water and vault toilets are available. There is no dump station at this campground but there is a fill station as you enter the park') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/swan-lake-campground, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Seasons of Use: Mid May - Late September'; concessionaire-run in the summer months.

Run in summer by concessionaire Big Sky Recreation Company. 24 sites reservable on recreation.gov, 14 first-come walk-up sites (marked W). Reserved sites are held until 11 a.m. the day after arrival; a reservation holder may not move to a walk-up site. 16-day stay limit. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234480 (overview, notices, maxConsecutiveStay 16) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/swan-lake-campground ('managed by a concessionaire, Big Sky Recreation Company, during the summer months'; '16 day stay limit'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $22 per camping unit per night; an additional camping unit on a double site pays another $22 (cash or check at the fee tube), and a second vehicle $5/night.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234480/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-30: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $22) + notices ('additional $22/per nite', 'extra vehicle charge of $5.00/vehicle per night'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/swan-lake-campground ('A 50% discount on all standard site fees and day use fees will be offered to holders of the Golden Age and Golden Access Passports, as well as holders of the Interagency Senior and Access Passes'), read 2026-10-22

note: Flathead NF at the north end of Swan Lake, ~17 mi SE of Bigfork. Two loops (Ponderosa open/large sites, Birch shaded); boat ramp and swim beach on the lake side of Hwy 83. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 38 sites (24 reservable / 14 walk-up), 50-ft max trailer, no electric, rec.gov booking with some FCFS, 16-day limit, $22 (2026). Added season (mid May - late September), vault toilets/potable water/no dump (fill station), senior/access 50% discount, concessionaire Big Sky Recreation Company. Not stated: booking window (inherited 6 months left). Note trimmed of restated values.
